title: Tututor.ai / EduNova
summary: One bug fix became three rebuilds, eight products, and a platform used by 20k+ students, teachers and families.

Shipped three React Native apps to both stores. Started a Kotlin Multiplatform core with SwiftUI and Jetpack Compose.
Led three app developers and a couple of web developers. Taught the founder to code; today the two of us run the product.

title: Frequently asked questions
summary: Tools, remote work, communication, timescales, support and payments.

title: What do you build with?
summary: Usually React, Next.js and TypeScript on the frontend; Node, Express and MongoDB on the backend. For AI, I use OpenAI, Claude, Gemini and ElevenLabs according to the job. Mobile work spans React Native and native interfaces.

title: Can you work with a team in Europe or the US?
summary: I’m in Pakistan, UTC+5, and already work remotely with teams in Spain and Denmark. We can agree on overlap with your working day, including US hours, before we start.

title: How will we stay in touch?
summary: Directly with me. We’ll agree on a shared channel, keep decisions in writing, and review working previews as the project develops.

title: How long does a project take?
summary: That depends on the scope and the state of the existing product. Send me what you have and what needs to change; I’ll propose milestones before we commit to a timeline.

title: Can you take over an existing app?
summary: Yes. I’ve rebuilt Tututor three times and worked through migrations, slow APIs and fragile AI flows. I start by understanding what already works and where the real constraints are.

title: What happens after launch?
summary: We can include handoff, documentation and a defined support period in the scope, or work together on ongoing engineering. We’ll agree on this before the build.

title: How do pricing and payments work?
summary: I quote against an agreed scope. Payment milestones and any ongoing work are agreed before we start. If the scope changes, we discuss the effect on cost and timing first.

summary: Tell me what you’re building. We can talk through the problem and the scope.

title: Illume

title: Viloi
summary: I built Viloi from the writing experience through to subscription billing, using model fallbacks to handle varied AI output and automated billing to support a product with paying customers.
